name: slotforge
description: Design, validate, print and race HO slot car tracks.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @slotforge/core && npm run build -w @slotforge/studio && npm run build -w @slotforge/race
scripts.test: npm run test -w @slotforge/core && npm run test -w @slotforge/race
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
